tasks.title: Create the Supplier Scorecard Application
tasks.objective: Establish the application container and navigation for Supplier Scorecard configuration and operations.
tasks.scope: Create the Supplier Scorecard application, application-level settings, navigation areas, and placeholders for administration, contribution, review, published results, and reporting. Do not modify the OOTB SRM application or workflows. Add the three ordered application tabs Supplier Scorecards, Program Administration, and Program Development, and their nine named menu grouping headers. Create the tab and grouping shell here; final menu destinations, menu visibility bindings, and default views are completed with the view work after their targets exist.
tasks.deliverable: Supplier Scorecard application container with three ordered tab shells and nine ordered menu grouping headers, ready for later menu and view bindings.
tasks.blockedStatus: Ready for application, tab, and grouping-label configuration. Final menu links and default views are completed by the later view assignment after its configured targets and security policies exist.
tasks.rationale: This is bounded application setup using an established Intelex pattern; Senior Consultant review protects the SRM boundary.
tasks.assumptions: The three tab and grouping shells can be created before their final menu destinations are bound. Final native menu/default settings are addressed in the later view assignment; no live tenant configuration is claimed.

tasks.title: Configure the Scorecard Catalogues
tasks.objective: Make each catalogue usable as a governed Code-based selection source.
tasks.scope: Configure inherited `Code`, `Name`, `Active?`, and `Sort`; add `Description` to KPI Aggregation Method and `Frequency` to Scorecard Cadence; configure child administration forms, active-record filters, audit, and basic permissions. Do not expose inverse consumer grids. Replace the proposed blanket catalogue-maintenance grant with two explicit sets: the three business classification catalogues allow maintenance by the Supplier Scorecard Application Administrator group or members of Administrators; the ten technical catalogues allow maintenance only by members of Administrators. Retain the read access needed to select supported values and display historical references. Apply the same maintenance division to inherited and directly declared editable fields.
tasks.deliverable: Catalogue forms and fields with the approved three-business/ten-technical maintenance division, authorized lookup access, active-selection filtering, and existing audit and lifecycle restrictions.

predecessorOutputs.description: Abstract catalogue parent and twelve correctly inherited concrete child objects.

tasks.blockedStatus: Partly waiting. The catalogue field/form work and known access rules can be prepared after the catalogue objects exist. Applying user privileges waits for the relevant Group bindings and membership. Only Generation Lag Time Increment permissions additionally wait for that object and form from the separate scheduling amendment. Inherited-Code uniqueness and recurrence storage still use the existing supplied capability results.
tasks.rationale: Inherited fields, recurrence presentation, and inverse suppression exceed simple catalogue setup.
tasks.assumptions: This changes the planned maintenance grant, not any catalogue fields, inheritance, supported Codes, or seed values. Ordinary object audit, active filtering, and catalogue inverse suppression remain part of the original catalogue assignment.

suppliedInputDescriptions.description: Supply the supported inherited-Code uniqueness and recurrence storage/display behavior used by the existing catalogue configuration. Only the affected constraints and Frequency configuration wait for those results.
Supply the native Group bindings and membership for Supplier Scorecard Application Administrator and Administrators so the two catalogue-maintenance sets can be assigned accurately.
Supply the Generation Lag Time Increment object and administration form from the separate scheduling amendment; only its catalogue privilege assignment waits for this target.

Inherited Code editability
Apply the concrete catalogue maintenance rule to Code. Code remains editable only before first use and stable afterward; do not redeclare the inherited field.
Inherited Name editability
Apply the concrete catalogue maintenance rule to Name, retaining its localizable display-label behavior; do not redeclare the inherited field.
Inherited Active? editability
Apply the concrete catalogue maintenance rule to Active?. Retain existing inactive references on version and historical records; do not redeclare the inherited field.
Inherited Sort editability
Apply the concrete catalogue maintenance rule to Sort without redeclaring the inherited field.
KPI Aggregation Method.Description editability
Allow editing only by members of Administrators. Changing a catalogue record does not itself implement a new supported aggregation algorithm.
Scorecard Cadence.Frequency editability

Allow editing only by members of Administrators before the Cadence is referenced by a published Program Version. Keep Frequency stable after that first published use; a materially different schedule requires a new Cadence record.
Catalogue lookup access

Allow authorized users of consuming records to read and select the permitted active catalogue records without granting catalogue-maintenance rights; retain read access to inactive values already referenced by historical or version records.
steps: Apply the business and technical catalogue maintenance rules to the relevant record and field permissions.
Configure the lookup/read permissions independently from record maintenance so program administrators can continue choosing supported methods on KPI, Program, benchmark, and operational forms.
accept: An application-admin user without Administrators membership can maintain Supplier Commodity, NAICS Classification, and KPI Category, and can select supported technical catalogue values on consuming forms.
The same application-admin user cannot maintain any of the ten technical catalogues through the administration form, a direct URL, API, or import/update path.
A member of Administrators can maintain the technical catalogues subject to existing stable-Code, used-Cadence, and historical-reference restrictions.
Code, Name, Active?, and Sort remain inherited; Description remains declared on KPI Aggregation Method and Frequency on Scorecard Cadence.

tasks.title: Configure Supplier Scorecard Security
tasks.objective: Restrict administration, contribution, aggregate viewing, corrections, publication, and supplier access while preserving source security.
tasks.scope: Configure application/object/record/workflow permissions for administrators, coordinators, reviewers, contributors, correction users, internal viewers, and supplier users; enforce supplier-entity scope, parent/child access rules, internal-only fields, read-only published results, and no access expansion from Group assignment. Add the three tab-audience policies and the applicable-review authorization policy that final menu assembly will consume. Supplier Scorecards allows authorized internal SIA viewers; Program Administration allows the Supplier Scorecard Application Administrator group and members of Administrators; Program Development allows members of Administrators only. Tab membership must not grant additional contributor, coordinator, reviewer, correction, override, or publication actions.
tasks.deliverable: Existing scorecard record/action security plus three tab-audience policies and an applicable-review authorization policy ready for final menu/view binding.

predecessorOutputs.description: Completed Run, Scorecard, and Contribution Task workflows.
Publish Scorecards action and specified notification behavior.

tasks.blockedStatus: Partly waiting. Existing form, workflow, and publication predecessors remain required. The access rules are decided; assigning them waits for the affected Group bindings and membership and the existing supplier-scope/correction/recipient security inputs. Final menu-record visibility is applied later by the menu/view assignment, so this task does not depend on those later menu records.
tasks.rationale: Nuanced cross-object, workflow, source, parent/facility, and supplier security requires senior technical authority.
tasks.assumptions: Catalogue record/field maintenance grants are configured by the catalogue assignment. This assignment owns user-access policies and existing record/action security; final menu records and their visibility bindings are configured by the later view assignment.

suppliedInputDescriptions.description: Supply coordinator, review, correction, contributor, and support Group assignments and the approved separation of duties used by the original security task; these are distinct from the already decided tab labels and Administrators requirement.

tasks.title: Configure Scorecard Views and Reports
tasks.objective: Provide operational oversight, published detail, profile drilldown, category results, trends, and on-demand authorized ranking.
tasks.scope: Configure responsive entry/review/admin/published views, supplier-profile grids, overdue and completeness reports, snapshot-aware KPI reporting, category aggregation, current-measure workspace links, and secured overall/commodity rank calculation without persisted rank fields. Add the named overview, history, contribution-progress, review, and reported-data views and complete the 24 ordered menu destinations across the three tab shells. Bind the audience and review-visibility policies supplied by the security work. Set Supplier Scorecards to open Scorecard Overview and the other two tabs to open blank content areas until a menu is selected. Omit My Contribution Tasks; retain all earlier reporting, responsive-view, ranking, and supplier-profile scope.
tasks.deliverable: Existing scorecard report/view set plus 24 ordered menu links with secured visibility and the approved Overview, Blank, Blank tab defaults.

predecessorOutputs.description: Verified KPI Value and parent-total calculation handlers.
Existing scorecard record/action security plus three tab-audience policies and an applicable-review authorization policy ready for final menu/view binding.
Usable KPI authoring and immutable-version forms.
Program/version administration forms and Generation Delay object/form/grid.

tasks.blockedStatus: Partly waiting. Complete the earlier calculation, security, KPI-form, and Program-form outputs before binding their destinations. Menu labels and destination purposes are decided; only unverified native binding settings wait for supplied support details. Only the Generation Lag Time Increments link additionally waits for its catalogue object/form from the separate scheduling amendment. Existing ranking and report/query inputs still block their affected reporting features.
tasks.rationale: Cross-object reporting and secured query ranking require broader technical judgment but not bespoke UI architecture.
tasks.assumptions: The three tab shells and grouping labels come from the application task; catalogue privileges and security policies come from their named earlier outputs. Existing task notification links and contribution entry/completion behavior remain in use. No new data object, field, Power BI dataset, or custom audit object is assigned by this amendment.

steps: Create the named overview and supplemental views using the existing configured objects, responsive forms, and native reporting.
Bind the 24 menu items to the stated destinations in the stated tab/group order, and apply the three tab-audience policies plus the applicable-review condition to their navigation visibility.

accept: The final navigation contains three tabs, nine grouping headers, and 24 menu items: five under Supplier Scorecards, nine under Program Administration, and ten under Program Development.
Opening Supplier Scorecards displays Scorecard Overview. Opening Program Administration or Program Development displays blank content until a menu is selected.
Each of the 24 menu items opens its named object inventory or view, and Scorecards in Review is shown only to users authorized for the applicable reporting cycle.
Program and KPI Versions open through their authoring records, and Generation Delay creation remains through the controlled Program grid action.

The three business catalogue menus permit the assigned business maintainers, while the ten technical catalogue menus require Administrators membership; selecting supported values on consuming forms does not grant maintenance.
Contribution Progress is read only, My Contribution Tasks is absent, and no abstract-catalogue or standalone unrestricted Generation Delay creation menu is introduced.
